```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="desk">

  <!-- ==================== -->
  <!--   Desk Top (link)   -->
  <!-- ==================== -->
  <link name="top">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.715" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.17 0.55 0.03"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="oak">
        <color rgba="0.55 0.27 0.07 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.715" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.17 0.55 0.03"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <mass value="10.0"/>
      <!-- Box inertia about its own center -->
      <inertia ixx="0.5" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.5" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.2"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- ==================== -->
  <!--   Four Legs (links) -->
  <!-- ==================== -->
  <!-- Leg positions are at the four corners, inset 0.05 m from edges -->
  <xacro:macro name="leg" params="name x y">
    <link name="${name}">
      <visual>
        <origin xyz="${x} ${y} 0.365" rpy="0 0 0"/>
        <geometry>
          <box size="0.05 0.05 0.73"/>
        </geometry>
        <material name="metal">
          <color rgba="0.7 0.7 0.7 1"/>
        </material>
      </visual>
      <collision>
        <origin xyz="${x} ${y} 0.365" rpy="0 0 0"/>
        <geometry>
          <box size="0.05 0.05 0.73"/>
        </geometry>
      </collision>
      <inertial>
        <mass value="2.0"/>
        <inertia ixx="0.02" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
                 iyy="0.02" iyz="0.0"
                 izz="0.001"/>
      </inertial>
    </link>

    <joint name="${name}_joint" type="fixed">
      <parent link="world"/>
      <child link="${name}"/>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    </joint>
  </xacro:macro>

  <xacro:leg name="leg_front_left"  x="-0.56" y="-0.25"/>
  <xacro:leg name="leg_front_right" x=" 0.56" y="-0.25"/>
  <xacro:leg name="leg_back_left"   x="-0.56" y=" 0.25"/>
  <xacro:leg name="leg_back_right"  x=" 0.56" y=" 0.25"/>

  <!-- ==================== -->
  <!--   Drawer (link)     -->
  <!-- ==================== -->
  <link name="drawer">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0.15 0.55" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.07 0.30 0.15"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="drawer_mat">
        <color rgba="0.8 0.8 0.6 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0.15 0.55" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.07 0.30 0.15"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <mass value="5.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.12" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.12" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.02"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- Fixed joint attaching drawer to the desk top (frame) -->
  <joint name="drawer_fixed" type="fixed">
    <parent link="top"/>
    <child link="drawer"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0.58" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Prismatic joint for sliding motion -->
  <joint name="drawer_slide" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="world"/>
    <child link="drawer"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 -1 0"/>
    <limit lower="0.0" upper="0.25" effort="30" velocity="0.1"/>
    <dynamics damping="0.1" friction="0.2"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- ==================== -->
  <!--   World (link)      -->
  <!-- ==================== -->
  <link name="world"/>
</robot>
```
